body:
S459-31's per-box wall lighting is real per-box flat shading, so its halo was necessarily blocky/square. Added draw_light_glow_billboard: a soft, camera-facing, additively-blended round glow sprite at each fixture (radial smoothstep+squared alpha falloff, no hard edge) -- the standard forward-renderer technique for this, much cheaper than a real framebuffer gaussian blur/bloom post-process. Live-verified via Xvfb: a real, visible, round white-hot glow now radiates from the IPS panel and fades smoothly outward. Commit 602d2e0.

⚓ ☃
title: Soft round glow billboard for IPS/HPS light fixtures (fixes blocky halo)
